private_lines.Maya: You work as a night-shift radiographer at the Leicester Royal Infirmary, so this week you are on a run of four nights and sleeping through the afternoons.
private_lines.Tom: You are a self-employed plumber who lives out in Oadby, and this week you are juggling a backlog of boiler callouts and a kitchen refit for a client who keeps changing the tile order.
private_lines.Jo: You teach Year 3 at a primary school in Narborough, and this week you are preparing for parents' evenings while also looking after your dad, who has just come home from hospital after a hip operation.
private_lines.Sam: You run a small coffee roastery from a unit on an industrial estate in Braunstone, and this week you are preparing for the Christmas wholesale orders, which means very early starts and no spare evenings.

setting: You and your three friends all live in the same small city in the Midlands, Leicester, and met years ago through a shared running club that you have all since drifted away from, but the group chat has survived.
